"* * * * *" => Every minute
"*/15 0 1,15 * 1-5" => At */15 past 0on 1,15 of * (1-5)
"0 0 1 1 *" => At 12:00 AM on January 1st
"30 4 * * 0" => Every Sunday at 4:30 AM
"0 */2 * * * *" => At */2 past *0 on * of * (*)
"61 * * * *" => error: cron parse error in minutes field at position 0: expected value 0-59, found '6'
